description: Cheapest check: does this Québec contractor hold an ACTIVE RBQ licence right now? Returns active true/false, licence number, name, NEQ, city, restriction flag and authorized work categories. Use to vet many contractors fast; use qc-contractor-check for RENA and penalties. Input: name, NEQ or RBQ licence number. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/qc-licence with an x402 client.
